comments.author: Top_Measurement7815
comments.body:
Really nice game! Mind sharing a bit more on your workflow? How did you do the models, and how long have you been working on this

I agree with others you should consider making it a full game on steam for this

replies.author: Sea-Sandwich-8348
replies.body:
Sure! It’s very iterative overall, I don’t ever really go for big swings or “one shots”. For example, when I had the idea for this game, I started by getting basic shapes (pills and cubes and sphere) to do some basic ball swing, land on a plain, pick it up. The one-shot prompts I feel make it lose taste.

I’m a professional SWE by day, so I do some hand coding and mostly code reviewing and small tweaks.

I’m a blender novice, so it handles a lot of the 3d modeling via Claude blender mcp. I do some manual modeling though.

It’s a pretty hands on workflow overall, but it works well for keeping a project in the intended direction
